step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents HBO's AWS cloud linear playout architecture. Content/master files originate from Atlanta (TWD / CNN Center) and are uploaded to an S3 bucket. CloudFormation provisions EC2 instances across availability zones, managed by Auto Scaling Groups (ASG). Master files from S3 are transferred to EC2 instances running Evertz ORT software for playout processing. Played out streams pass through AWS Direct Connect back to on-premises / uplinks: one path goes directly to NYC (Hudson Yards) as a BCP solution, while another tertiary path (X-chain) returns to Techwood / CNN Center on-premises datacenter, which then feeds the Atlanta (ATL) uplink.
